text:
Ava: Quick shoutout — massive thanks to infra + SRE (Priya & Samir) for the midnight scaling patch. Saved the data-import job and our demo tomorrow. :pray: Also big props to Design for the last-minute illustrations, they look amazing. Anyone up for a tiny token? cactus cards or something small? :seedling:
Priya: Team effort — Samir ran the rollout at 02:14 and I watched logs. Appreciate everyone staying on call. :tada:
Samir: Happy it landed clean. I dropped a short runbook gist for the escalation steps: https://rdw.in/gist/scale-runbook — please ping if anything's unclear.
Jon K.: Adding my :clap: for Support who owned the customer threads during the spike. Helped us prioritize fixes quickly.
Maya: Ooh cactus cards sound adorable. I have a small stash of succulents at HQ — happy to coordinate pickup/delivery if that helps. :cactus:
Ava: @Maya that would be awesome. I'll follow up with People Ops for budget + labels.
Priya: Also low-key shoutout to @Ava for calm triage energy — made the call much easier. :star2:
Jon K.: Quick poll — react with :cactus: if you want a plant, :coffee: for a coffee gift card, :tada: for either. I'll tally in the morning.
Samir: Adding a tiny note: we tagged the fix with `hotfix/scale-2245` and created a follow-up ticket to automate the check. (reaction: :white_check_mark:)
Ava: Thank you all — coordinating a short celebratory note in the weekly all-hands for the cross-team rescue. Micro-kudos go a long way. :heart:
Slackbot: This thread will be archived in #random after 7 days unless pinned.
